subject.title: feat: add per-agent daily model spend alerts

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a supported core configuration and per-agent SQLite contract for best-effort daily model-spend alerts, including deliberate at-most-once notification delivery?
rationale: The implementation adds a new user-facing configuration mode and persistent state rather than fixing an existing documented behavior; tests can validate mechanics but cannot choose whether these ongoing semantics belong in core.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded core feature
options.body: Accept the opt-in, provider-neutral alert contract once real owner-route proof and upgrade-focused review establish the intended delivery semantics.

options.title: Narrow the scope before acceptance
options.body: Request a smaller core accounting seam or different notification contract before accepting a permanent configuration and persisted-state surface.

options.title: Defer the product direction
options.body: Keep the linked feature discussion open without merging this implementation until there is maintainer demand for proactive per-agent spend alerts.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded core feature
recommendation.body: Accept the opt-in, provider-neutral alert contract once real owner-route proof and upgrade-focused review establish the intended delivery semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: No reliable current-main ownership trail was available in the supplied context.
